decision: Guarded physical dispatch enabled only in explicit ARC modules; tracing default unchanged. Measured modest CPU gains with larger ARC binaries; full ARC-versus-tracing readiness remains unproven. Existing DARTFORGE_NO_ARC_TAG_GUARDS=1 allows size-oriented ablation.
scope: Matched fixed70fc native producer experiment, not current full-toolchain upstream comparison requested later. Three alternating pairs; usual idle desktop background; agents CPU jobs paused.
